articles.title: Ganges Delta Under a Winter Shroud of Fog
articles.summary: Low clouds blanketed the delta while parallel cloud bands rolled over the Bay of Bengal during a January cold wave.

articles.title: Crew-11 to cut mission short and return to Earth due to medical issue
articles.summary: In keeping with the agency's strict medical privacy policy, NASA officials have not identified the astronaut in question or provided any details about the nature of the medical issue.

articles.title: NASA DECIDES TO BRING CREW-11 HOME EARLY, BUT NOT AN EMERGENCY
articles.summary: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman has decided to bring Crew-11 home early because of a medical concern affecting one of the crew members. NASA is not revealing who it is to […]

articles.title: NASA Crew-11 Will Return Early Due to Medical Situation
articles.summary: NASA’s Crew-11 mission to the International Space Station will make an unprecedented early return to Earth due to a medical situation involving one of the four astronauts.

articles.title: Medical issue prompts early return of Crew-11 from ISS
articles.summary:
NASA has decided to bring home early four members of the International Space Station crew because of a medical issue with one of them, a first for NASA.
